name: ssh.exe
description: Ssh.exe is the OpenSSH compatible client can be used to connect to Windows 10 (build 1809 and later) and Windows Server 2019 devices.
author: Akshat Pradhan

commands.description: Executes specified command on host machine. The prompt for password can be eliminated by adding the host's public key in the user's authorized_keys file. Adversaries can do the same for execution on remote machines.
commands.usecase: Execute specified command, can be used for defense evasion.
Performs execution of specified file, can be used as a defensive evasion.

detection: Event ID 4624 with process name C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\sshd.exe.
